items.item_text: 01. Golden West College is committed to fostering a culture of inclusive excellence by uplifting employees and students through an environment that is equitable, diverse, inclusive, and accessible. When responding to the questions below, please provide clear examples with successful outcomes, offer instances where you applied job skills to enhance diversity, equity, and inclusion, as well as your input towards advancing the overall culture at your former workplace. Please confirm Yes to acknowledge that you have read and understand these guidelines. Options: Yes | No
02. This is a transfer job posting. Only active classified CCCD employees at EE-119 or above are eligible to apply. Are you a current active employee holding a role EE-119 or higher?

03. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current Resume (attachment) 3. A Cover Letter (attachment) Options: Yes | No
